html:
The Ballardong are an Aboriginal people of the Avon Valley in the southwest of Western Australia, around present day York and Northam. They are one of the language groups of the Noongar.

Their neighbours were the Whadjuk around Perth to the west, the Wiilman to the south and the Kalaamaya to the east. The Avon Valley was the first inland district settled after the founding of the Swan River Colony in 1829. York was founded in 1831, and Ballardong people were soon pushed from their best land and waterholes. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
